# scripts/AISystem/GuardRota.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/AISystem/GuardRota.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Owns a guard's station sequence: NONE -> GOING -> ENTER -> DOING -> EXIT.
Claims stations exclusively, times activities and exposes activity to GuardRig.
Stirring releases props/stations and plays the appropriate exit; sleeping reduces
hearing and disables sight. Gathering can temporarily lend a station and restore
this guard's own rota when the loan ends.

Base: `RefCounted`. Registered class: `none`.

- `enum Step { NONE, GOING, ENTER, DOING, EXIT }` — [Source:72](../../../../../scripts/AISystem/GuardRota.gd#L72)
